# Problem 1

*Try to copy your .fcs files from their current folder on your desktop to the "TargetFolder" on your drive using R*

**Answer**:

```{r}
#| eval: false
list.dirs(path = "D:")
```

![](images\1.png)

```{r}
#| eval: false
NewDir <- file.path("D:", "TargetFolder")
list.files(path=NewDir, full.names=FALSE, recursive=FALSE)
```

![](images\2.png)

```{r}
#| eval: false
fcsfiles <- list.files(path="data", pattern=".fcs", full.names= TRUE, recursive=FALSE)
fcsfiles
```

![](images\3.png)

```{r}
#| eval: false
file.copy(from=fcsfiles, to=NewDir)
```

![](images\4.png)

```{r}
#| eval: false
list.files(path=NewDir, full.names=TRUE, recursive=FALSE)
```

![](images\5.png)

# Problem 3

*Search your way down the file.directory of the FlowSOM and flowWorkspace packages, and identify any .fcs files that are present for use in the documentation.*

**Answer**:

```{r}
#| eval: false
DirFlowSOM <- file.path("C:/Users/epera/AppData/Local/R/win-library/4.5/FlowSOM/")
```
```{r}
#| eval: false
DirflowWorkspace <- file.path("C:/Users/epera/AppData/Local/R/win-library/4.5/flowWorkspace/")
```
Now we search for all .fcs files in all folders of each directory.

```{r}
#| eval: false
list.files(path=DirFlowSOM, pattern=".fcs", full.names=TRUE, recursive=TRUE)
```

[1] "C:/Users/epera/AppData/Local/R/win-library/4.5/FlowSOM/extdata/68983.fcs"

```{r}
#| eval: false
list.files(path=DirflowWorkspace, pattern=".fcs", full.names=TRUE, recursive=TRUE)
```
character(0)

There are no .fcs files.
